name: Lane Guard
description: Generalized cross-lane pollution barrier: per-lane protected directories, per-lane sudo arm windows, owner-gated session bindings with child inheritance. Fires on exec, write, edit, apply_patch at priority 900.

excludePaths.description: Paths excluded from all lane protection (exclusion wins)
